excluded: Source-project MATLAB behavior, graphics, global root scans and arbitrary analytic continuation.
preconditions: k is finite and strictly positive; outputs must remain representable in double precision.
supported: Finite positive real scalar k and finite normalized frequency, including representable complex upper/lower-plane values.

example.code:
from scirel.kinetic import evaluate_maxwellian_electrostatic
r=evaluate_maxwellian_electrostatic(1.2+0.3j,0.4)
assert abs(r["D"])>0
example.expected: Finite epsilon, D and phase argument.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for invalid, nonfinite, singular or incompatible inputs.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Solver and quadrature limits are explicit; failed residual checks raise RuntimeError.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial scientific result is returned after a failed call.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Unrepresentable evaluation raises ValueError; solver unrepresentable trial response raises RuntimeError. Unexpected SciPy execution errors propagate.

assumptions: A mode is identified only by an explicit seed and final residual test.
f0(v)=exp(-v²/2)/sqrt(2π), unit plasma frequency, thermal standard deviation one, perturbation convention exp(-i omega t).
identity.boundary: k is positive and omega finite; no global branch selection is performed.
identity.definition: epsilon=1+chi with chi=(1+z Z(z))/k²; for large |z| the equivalent Gaussian moment expansion is used to avoid cancellation, and D=k²epsilon remains a diagnostic.
identity.model: One-dimensional homogeneous Maxwellian with normalized unit plasma response

inputs.description: Complex normalized frequency, scalar or array.
inputs.name: omega

inputs.constraints: Finite strictly positive real scalar; booleans, complex values and arrays rejected.
inputs.name: k

outputs.description: Estimated arithmetic/asymptotic error of epsilon; not a rigorous enclosure.
outputs.name: epsilon_error

provenance.license_status: Uses NumPy and SciPy; their applicable license texts are carried with the selected distribution.
provenance.lineage_summary: Independent SciRel implementation of the normalized Maxwellian dielectric from its stated Faddeeva relation.
public_references: Hua-Sheng Xie, Generalized plasma dispersion function, Phys. Plasmas. 20 (2013), 092125 (scientific context)
SciPy scipy.special.wofz defining identity and Steven G. Johnson Faddeeva implementation reference
source_kinds: independent numerical regression and invariant tests

summary: Evaluate normalized Maxwellian dielectric with cancellation-free large-phase response.

verification.evidence_ceiling: Independent high-precision Faddeeva, Gaussian moments and seeded root calculations support the stated finite real/complex positive-k response and numerical error gate on the tested regimes; estimates are not certified enclosures.
known_limitations: epsilon_error is an estimate rather than a rigorous enclosure.
Finite inputs can have unrepresentable complex response; no root is inferred from an evaluation.
scope: Independent high-precision Faddeeva and Gaussian-moment references across real and complex positive-k domains.
Small-k omega=2 limit, finite representability, and shape/error reporting.
